newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-ANELKA CANNOT JOIN ARSENAL, SAYS LEAGUE CHIEF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ANELKA CANNOT JOIN ARSENAL, SAYS LEAGUE CHIEF.

text.p: Teenage striker Nicolas Anelka is not free to leave Paris Saint-Germain for Arsenal, according to French league president Noel Le Graet.
"Anelka can't sign with Arsenal without PSG's agreement," Le Graet was quoted as saying by sports daily l'Equipe on Thursday. "I'm going to ask the French Federation not to let him out."
The French league looks after professional clubs but when a player wants to leave the country, he needs a letter allowing him to do so which must be signed by the French Federation (FFF).
Le Graet said the FFF should ask UEFA to rule on the case.
Anelka has signed a two-year contract with Arsenal, managed by Frenchman Arsene Wenger. The player was unhappy at PSG, were he was not a first-choice player.

PSG's deputy chairman Michel Denisot said he would not let Anelka go. "We are going to fight on the legal front," he said. "This case points out a void in European regulations...I'm going to fight until the end to defend PSG's interests."
